thread:
Elaine: Quick PSA — I'm updating the quickstart hello-world tutorial to use SDK v0.8 auth pattern. Old snippet uses an `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>` header example; we should switch to the `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var and `RedwoodClient.from_env()` pattern.

Sam: Sounds good. Do we need a short migration note for existing users who follow the curl examples?

Elaine: Yes — one paragraph under "Upgrading the quickstart" explaining the env var and a curl example replacement. I'll open a docs PR and drop the updated snippets.

mohit: FYI the JS snippet also needs a rename: `client.deploy()` vs the old `await client.deploy(...)` — check the API surface. Also there was a tiny lint error in the bash code block.

Jonah: tagging @sam for review and @mohit for the runtime call rename. Also the curl example uses the old anchor `/docs#deploy` which 404s — need to fix that link to `/docs/quickstart/deploy`.

Sam: I'll update the code snippets and push a branch now — pushing to github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pulls/482 (WIP).

docs-bot: PR opened: elaine/update-quickstart-auth-snippet (#482) — CI queued.

Elaine: Added the migration blurb in the PR and swapped the python snippet. Tested locally with a dev token. Here's the python snippet I put in the docs:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient.from_env()
resp = client.generate("hello world")
print(resp.text)
```

Sam: LGTM. Can we also add one line about token scoping and which minimal role is required? People keep hitting 403s.

mohit: Good call. Add: "Token must have inference:invoke permission for hosted API" — short and sweet.

Elaine: Done. Also fixed the broken anchor and updated the deploy section link. Assigned screenshots to @jonah to sanity-check the UI step.

Jonah: I'll capture screenshots tomorrow and swap the old ones out.

docs-bot: PR #482 status: checks passed — ready to merge.

Elaine: Merged PR, updated changelog entry, and added a small redirection note to `/docs/quickstart` for older links. Closing out this thread. :tada:
